packs.title: Core Foundation
packs.purpose: The monorepo bootstrap layer: Express server wiring, Prisma schema + migrations, database client, JWT signing/verification, cookie management, Supabase storage client, all middleware, and the shared validators package. Every other pack depends on at least some of these files.
packs.mainFlow: App startup → Helmet/CORS/Rate-limit middleware → Route registration → SocketService init → Global error handler → process safety nets.

packs.title: Authentication & Sessions
packs.purpose: User registration, login, logout, and refresh-token rotation. Passwords are bcrypt-hashed. Refresh tokens are SHA-256 hashed before DB storage. Reuse of a revoked token triggers a full session wipe (theft detection).
packs.mainFlow: POST /api/auth/register → hash password → create user → create session → set HttpOnly cookies. POST /api/auth/login → verify password → rotate session. POST /api/auth/refresh → validate hash → revoke old → issue new. POST /api/auth/logout → revoke + clear cookies.

packs.title: Multi-Tenancy & Workspace System
packs.purpose: Workspace creation, invite-code based joining, workspace switching (re-issues JWT with workspaceId + role), and member management. The requireWorkspace middleware enforces that all subsequent API calls carry tenant context.
packs.mainFlow: POST /api/workspaces → create + set as OWNER. POST /api/workspaces/join → validate invite code → add as EMPLOYEE. POST /api/workspaces/:id/switch → re-sign JWT with workspaceId and role embedded.

packs.title: RBAC & Governance
packs.purpose: Role-Based Access Control enforced via the requirePermission middleware. Roles (OWNER, ADMIN, MANAGER, EMPLOYEE) map to explicit permission sets defined in the validators package. Audit log records every destructive action.
packs.mainFlow: Request hits route → requireAuth → requireWorkspace → requirePermission(Permission.X) → checks ROLE_PERMISSIONS[role] → 403 if missing. Audit events written via AuditService.log().

packs.title: Realtime Infrastructure
packs.purpose: Socket.io layer providing authenticated, workspace-scoped real-time connections. The HTTP handshake is intercepted to verify the same JWT as the REST API. Events are emitted only to workspace:${workspaceId} rooms via a centralized SocketService singleton.
packs.mainFlow: Client connects → socketAuthMiddleware parses HttpOnly cookie → verifyAccessToken → reject if no workspaceId → socket.data.user set → gateway joins workspace room → SocketService.broadcastToWorkspace() sends events.

packs.title: Projects & Kanban
packs.purpose: Projects, Kanban boards with columns, tasks with priority/status/labels, drag-and-drop position updates, task history tracking, and real-time task state synchronization via Socket.io.
packs.mainFlow: POST /api/projects → create project. GET /api/projects/:id/board → full board with columns+tasks. POST /api/tasks → create task in column. PATCH /api/tasks/:id/move → reorder task. Every mutation emits a socket event to the workspace room.

packs.title: Documents & Storage
packs.purpose: Folder hierarchy, file registration after Supabase presigned-URL upload, file rename/move/delete, share links with expiry, and cascading folder deletion. All storage paths are prefixed with workspaceId to guarantee tenant isolation at the bucket level.
packs.mainFlow: POST /api/storage/files/upload-url → returns Supabase presigned PUT URL. POST /api/storage/files → register file metadata in DB. POST /api/storage/files/:id/share → create time-limited share link. GET /api/storage/share/:token → resolve and redirect.

packs.title: Full Realtime Communication
packs.purpose: Public/Private channels, Direct Message channels, message sending with cursor-based pagination, thread replies, message reactions, message editing/deletion, and read receipts. All events broadcast to workspace socket rooms in real time.
packs.mainFlow: POST /api/channels → create channel. POST /api/messages → send message → emit socket event. POST /api/messages/:id/reactions → toggle reaction. GET /api/messages?channelId&before → paginated history. POST /api/messages/receipts/mark → mark as read.

packs.title: Global Search
packs.purpose: Cross-entity full-text search across tasks, messages, and files — all scoped to the active workspace. A single query endpoint fans out to three Prisma queries and merges the results into a typed union response.
packs.mainFlow: GET /api/search?q=term → SearchService.search(workspaceId, q) → concurrent prisma.task.findMany + prisma.message.findMany + prisma.file.findMany → merge → return typed hits array.

packs.title: Org Chart & Calendar
packs.purpose: Org chart with manager/report relationships (circular dependency prevention), leave request workflow (request → manager approve/reject → cancel), meeting scheduling with per-participant RSVP, and dynamic presence computation (ONLINE/BUSY/OUT_OF_OFFICE/OFFLINE) based on socket state, approved leaves, and accepted meetings.
packs.mainFlow: PUT /api/org/members/:id/manager → set manager (circular check). POST /api/calendar/leaves → request leave. PUT /api/calendar/leaves/:id → manager review. POST /api/calendar/meetings → schedule meeting. PUT /api/calendar/meetings/:id/rsvp → accept/decline. GET /api/presence/:userId → compute current status.

packs.title: AI Copilot
packs.purpose: Vercel AI SDK integration with OpenAI (gpt-4o). Five features: (1) streaming workspace-aware chat, (2) channel message summarization, (3) structured task enrichment using generateObject + Zod schema, (4) document Q&A via RAG pattern with Supabase Storage, (5) workspace assistant that injects live task context into the system prompt. All endpoints rate-limited (20 req/15min) to prevent financial DoS.
packs.mainFlow: POST /api/ai/chat → streamText → pipe to response. POST /api/ai/summarize/channel/:id → fetch messages → generateText. POST /api/ai/enrich/task/:id → generateObject (structured JSON). POST /api/ai/qa/document/:id → download from Supabase → generateText with doc context. POST /api/ai/assistant → fetch open tasks → inject into system prompt → streamText.
